Profile metadata

VERSION 1

All fields are required except the modification date.

A unique URI for this profile. Keep it when updating the same profile.

Use an ISO 8601 timestamp, for example 2026-11-25T12:00:00Z.

02

Theme colors

Choose a swatch or enter a CSS color. Previews are illustrative.

03

Images

Add your logo, welcome image, and assets used by HTML or CSS. Logo and welcome image paths must point to files inside the profile folder.

No images added.

04

Links

Add local HTML pages, online catalogs, and other links. Order is preserved; the first catalog is used for authentication when activating the profile.

No links added.

Welcome and navigation pages use local HTML files. Navigation pages need one h1 heading and styles scoped to .custom-profile-screen; Thorium sanitizes the content.

05

Publications

Add books with local files or remote acquisition links and covers. Use Advanced JSON for richer OPDS metadata.

No publications added.

06

Folder check

OPTIONAL

Select the profile folder containing your resources. Only relative filenames are checked; files are never uploaded or changed.

The draft has validation errors. This checklist covers the current JSON preview; fix errors before relying on the result.

    Checks update when you edit the manifest. Reselect the folder after changing files on disk. Missing files do not prevent saving; the CLI performs the final checks when packing.

    Files used only inside HTML or CSS need explicit manifest entries. This check does not inspect HTML or CSS for additional references.

    Save the file in your profile folder before packing.

    JSON

    Manifest preview

    Imported additional fields are preserved.

    Next: pack your profile

    Save manifest.json in your profile folder alongside its resources, then use the profile CLI to pack it.
